explanation: Special case of erdosproblems.com/70 (β = ω·2, n = 4): RealCardinalRamsey3 (ω * 2) 4, i.e. every 2-colouring of triples of reals has a red set of order type ω + ω or a blue 4-set. Mathlib's ordinal product ω * 2 is ω + ω, the least ordinal not covered by the Erdős–Rado result λ → (ω+n, 4)³ quoted on the page, as the docstring says. A correctly stated instance of the main question; I could not independently confirm from the page that this particular case is still open (the page lists no later progress).
